newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Oct 30.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Oct 30.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Wednesday:
** Indonesia was seen facing difficulties in exporting its textile products in the year 2000 due to weak investment for new machines, an official with the country's textile association said.

** The Dow Jones industrial average rose 34.29 points to 6,007.02 on Tuesday after the latest economic reports calmed investor worries about inflation and sent interest rates tumbling to the lowest levels in nearly seven months.
** The Jakarta Composite Index closed 0.48 points, or 0.08 percent, higher at 567.75 points on Tuesday following late active buying of some big-capitalised stocks and secondaries.
** On Wednesday, the Indonesian rupiah was at 2,327.85/28.00 in early trading against an opening of 2,328.00/28.50.
** Cement counter Semen Gresik on its announcement of nine-month profits of 193.98 billion rupiah, more than double the figure for the year-ago period.

** Automobile conglomerate Astra on reports that some large business groups which recently bought large stakes in the company were expected to submit reports on the purchase to the capital markets supervisory agency in the next two days.
** Textile firm Pan Brothers Tex on reports of a plan to divest stakes in privately-owned firms PT Pancaplaza Indotextile, PT Charpan Buana and PT Pancaprima Ekabrothers.
** Property firm Suryamas Duta Makmur on market talk of a possible rights issue.
** Property firm Ometraco Realty on a plan to acquire private-owned property firms PT Angkasa Interland and PT Lestari Basuki.
** Secondliner Intraco Penta on reports of a stock split to 500 rupiah from the previous 1,000 rupiah.
